title: Device Management
disableConfirmTitle: Disable this device? Once disabled, no data from it will be processed at all.
deleteConfirmContent: This permanently deletes the device and all of its history (telemetry, alert rules, etc.) — this cannot be undone.

import.title: Batch Import Devices
import.instructions: Pre-register devices ahead of time (e.g. from a production batch's serial-number list) — one row per device: sn,pid,name (name is optional). A header row starting with "sn" is detected and skipped automatically. This is only a convenience: a device that's never imported still registers itself the moment it first reports.
